The Chinese government has consistently adhered to the principles of one China, safeguarding national sovereignty and territorial integrity. Any act aimed at dividing the motherland or splitting the country is not only against the fundamental interests of the Chinese nation, but also violates the spirit of the Constitution and relevant laws.
